incidents.title: Security forces fire on protesters in Azna
incidents.summary: Verified videos and witness testimony document security forces firing near the county governor's office and a police station in Azna; at least six protesters were reported killed.
key_claims: Security forces fired toward protesters near Azadegan Square.
Security forces opened fire again after protesters regrouped outside a police station.
At least six protesters were killed in Azna.
incidents.address: Azadegan Square and nearby police station

incidents.title: IRGC agents fire from Malekshahi Basij base
incidents.summary: Multiple verified videos show agents inside a Basij base firing as protesters fled; five named protesters were reported killed.
key_claims: IRGC agents fired from inside the Basij base toward protesters.
Verified videos show protesters fleeing amid gunfire.
Five protesters were identified as killed.

incidents.title: Two protesters killed in Lordegan
incidents.summary: A joint Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch investigation identified Ahmad Jalil and Sajad Valamanesh as killed by security forces during protests in Lordegan.
key_claims: Ahmad Jalil and Sajad Valamanesh were killed during the Lordegan protests.
Body images reviewed by investigators showed patterns consistent with metal-pellet wounds.

incidents.title: Soroush Soleimani killed in Hafshejan
incidents.summary: Investigators documented the killing of Soroush Soleimani during protests in Hafshejan and reviewed body images consistent with shotgun pellet injuries.
key_claims: Soroush Soleimani was killed during the Hafshejan protests.
Investigators reviewed body images showing metal-pellet wound patterns.

incidents.title: Protester shot with a pellet in Dehdasht
incidents.summary: A protester reported being shot during demonstrations in Dehdasht; an independent pathologist reviewed an injury photograph and found it consistent with a shotgun pellet wound.
key_claims: A protester was shot during the Dehdasht demonstrations.
Independent medical review found the documented injury consistent with a shotgun pellet wound.

incidents.title: Photographer documents pellet wounds in Ilam
incidents.summary: A photographer in Ilam published video showing a bloodied face covered with pellet wounds and displayed a recovered metal pellet.
key_claims: The photographer displayed facial injuries consistent with metal pellets.
The video showed a recovered metal pellet.
The injury was documented during the Ilam protest crackdown.

incidents.title: Security forces attack Imam Khomeini Hospital in Ilam
incidents.summary: Verified footage and witness evidence show FARAJA Special Forces and IRGC agents firing pellets and tear gas into hospital grounds, breaking doors, and beating patients, relatives, and medical staff.
key_claims: FARAJA Special Forces and IRGC agents entered or attacked the hospital grounds.
Agents fired shotguns loaded with metal pellets and tear gas.
Patients, relatives, and medical workers were beaten.

incidents.title: Kahrizak morgue footage documents mass casualties
incidents.summary: Five analyzed videos showed at least 205 distinct body bags at the Kahrizak forensic complex; Human Rights Watch independently counted at least 400 bodies visible across verified and geolocated footage.
key_claims: The Kahrizak forensic complex was used as an overflow morgue.
Amnesty International identified at least 205 distinct body bags across five videos.
Human Rights Watch independently counted at least 400 bodies visible in verified footage.

incidents.title: At least 120 body bags documented at Behesht Zahra
incidents.summary: Amnesty International analyzed video and four photographs from Behesht Zahra and counted at least 120 body bags linked to the January 8-9 crackdown.
key_claims: At least 120 body bags were visible in analyzed visual material.
The bodies were described as having been brought after the 8-9 January crackdown.
A victim's relative corroborated that the morgue was overflowing.

incidents.title: Bodies documented inside Alghadir Hospital
incidents.summary: Video published on 9 January showed 10 to 12 bodies inside Alghadir Hospital in eastern Tehran.
key_claims: Video from Alghadir Hospital showed 10 to 12 bodies.
The footage was published during the 8-9 January crackdown and analyzed by Amnesty International.

incidents.title: Police fire from rooftop on Rashid 115 Street
incidents.summary: A six-minute video filmed on Rashid 115 Street in Tehranpars shows security forces firing from the rooftop of a police station while protesters and bystanders flee.
key_claims: Security forces fired from the rooftop of a police station.
Protesters and bystanders fled during the firing.
The footage was filmed on Rashid 115 Street on 9 January 2026.

incidents.title: Security forces fire from elevated positions in Vakilabad
incidents.summary: Two analyzed videos show security forces firing from elevated positions and pursuing protesters in Mashhad's Vakilabad area, corroborated by eyewitness and medical accounts.
key_claims: Security forces fired from elevated positions in Vakilabad.
Agents pursued protesters amid gunfire.
Eyewitness and medical evidence corroborated direct firing and injuries.

incidents.title: Armed security patrols and gunfire documented in Karaj
incidents.summary: Analyzed videos recorded gunfire and showed dozens of armed security personnel patrolling a Karaj street on 10 January.
key_claims: Gunfire was audible in analyzed Alborz footage.
Dozens of armed security personnel were filmed patrolling in Karaj on 10 January.

incidents.title: Fardis hospital footage and medical testimony document mass casualties
incidents.summary: Videos showed motionless and severely injured people in a hospital associated with the Fardis crackdown; medical testimony reported 87 bodies at Soleimani Hospital and 423 injured people at Parsian Hospital.
key_claims: Hospital footage showed multiple motionless and severely injured people.
A medical worker reported 87 bodies at Soleimani Hospital.
The same account reported 423 injured people at Parsian Hospital.
Human Rights Watch independently reviewed footage reportedly from Fardis.
limitations: The exact capture location and date of some hospital footage could not be independently confirmed; the core mass-casualty finding is corroborated by separate medical testimony and independently reviewed footage.
IranArchive has not yet mirrored the underlying media.

incidents.title: Shotgun fire and violent arrests on Golha Boulevard
incidents.summary: Several verified videos show uniformed and plainclothes agents on Golha Boulevard carrying shotguns, violently arresting people, and firing or reloading a shotgun.
key_claims: Uniformed and plainclothes agents conducted violent arrests.
Agents carried shotguns while patrolling Golha Boulevard.
Shotgun firing and reloading are audible in verified footage.

incidents.title: Security forces fire toward traffic in Maskan
incidents.summary: A geolocated video shows armed security forces rushing toward protesters in Maskan and a man repeatedly firing a shotgun toward cars in traffic.
key_claims: The footage was geolocated to Maskan in Kermanshah.
Armed security forces moved toward protesters.
A man repeatedly fired a shotgun toward vehicles in traffic.

incidents.title: Live gunfire documented in Gilan-e Gharb
incidents.summary: Two videos and corroborating eyewitness accounts document protesters fleeing amid gunfire and security forces using live ammunition in Gilan-e Gharb.
key_claims: Gunfire is audible in two videos from Gilan-e Gharb.
One video shows protesters fleeing while shots are heard.
Eyewitness testimony corroborated the use of live ammunition.

incidents.title: Heavily armed patrol documented on Takhti Boulevard
incidents.summary: Video analyzed by Amnesty International shows armed personnel, lethal firearms, tank trucks, and repurposed trucks apparently configured as water cannons on Takhti Boulevard.
key_claims: Armed security forces were deployed along Takhti Boulevard.
Personnel carried lethal firearms.
The convoy included tank trucks and vehicles apparently repurposed as water cannons.

incidents.title: Armored security convoy documented in Tonekabon
incidents.summary: Video analyzed by Amnesty International shows dozens of security vehicles, motorcycles, and an armored personnel carrier transporting agents through Shiroudi Boulevard.
key_claims: Dozens of security-force vehicles moved through Shiroudi Boulevard.
The convoy included motorcycles and an armored personnel carrier.
The footage was analyzed as part of Amnesty International's clampdown investigation.

incidents.title: Strike on Shajareh Tayyebeh Elementary School
incidents.summary: Independent investigations found that a guided US weapon directly struck the school, killing 156 people, including 120 children.
key_claims: The school building was directly struck by a guided weapon.
The strike killed 156 people.
At least 120 of those killed were children.
Independent Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch investigations documented the attack.
